name: process-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the engineering-process category in one install — git workflow, approach deliberation (build-vs-buy, estimation, rollout, pattern selection folded in), hindsight mining, docs discipline (api-design), subagent orchestration, task execution, stack scanning, plugin scouting, a token-cost warn hook (lean), file-aware skill auto-routing (skill-router), a stronger-model second opinion when stuck (fresh-take), a refuting research harness (ultra-deep-research), and a committed codebase map (brain). Uninstall cleanly with /process-suite:uninstall — removes the bundle and prunes its auto-installed plugins. 200k-window installs: see the README's context-window requirement first.
